t.t: Answers to common questions about booking, diagnostics, estimates and vehicle services at DriveCore.

div.p: Find quick information about appointments, inspections, service recommendations and bringing your vehicle to DriveCore.
Appointments are recommended so we can plan the right amount of time for your vehicle. Submit the booking form or call us, and we will confirm availability.

article.button: Does submitting the online form confirm my booking?

div.p: No. The form sends us your requested date and service information. A member of the DriveCore team will contact you to confirm the appointment.

article.button: Do you service all makes and models?

div.p: We welcome a wide variety of cars and SUVs, including imported vehicles. Contact us with your make, model and concern so we can confirm the appropriate service.

article.button: Can you diagnose a dashboard warning light?

div.p: Yes. Diagnostics can include electronic scanning, live data review and a physical inspection. A fault code is a starting point; we work to identify the underlying cause.

article.button: Will I be told the cost before repairs begin?

div.p: Our goal is to explain the findings and recommended work before proceeding. Some complex faults require staged diagnosis, which will also be discussed with you.

article.button: What should I bring when dropping off my vehicle?

div.p: Bring the vehicle key and any useful information about the issue, including when it happens, recent repairs and warning messages. Remove valuable personal items before drop-off.

div.p: How DriveCore handles information submitted through this website.

We may collect information you voluntarily submit through our contact or booking forms, including your name, phone number, email address, vehicle details, preferred service date and description of the vehicle concern.
Information is used to respond to enquiries, discuss requested services, arrange appointments, provide customer support and maintain business records related to your request.

The website platform may process basic technical information needed for security, performance and normal operation. Any analytics or marketing tools added later should be reviewed and reflected in this policy.

DriveCore does not sell personal information. Information may be shared only with service providers that support normal business operations, when required to complete a requested service, or when required by law.
Reasonable administrative and technical measures are used to protect submitted information. No internet transmission or electronic storage system can be guaranteed completely secure.
Information may be retained for as long as reasonably necessary to manage the enquiry, appointment, customer relationship, legal obligations and business records.
You may contact DriveCore to request correction or deletion of information you previously submitted, subject to legal and legitimate business record requirements.
Questions about this policy can be sent to drive.core@outlook.com or 1 868 375 9633.
div.div: This starter policy is general website content and should be reviewed against the company's final practices and any professional legal advice before launch.

div.p: General terms governing use of the DriveCore website and online service requests.

The website provides general information about DriveCore Auto Import & Solutions Limited and its services. Content may be updated without notice and should not be treated as a final diagnosis, quotation or guarantee.
Submitting a booking form is a request for an appointment only. An appointment is confirmed only when DriveCore contacts the customer and agrees the date, time and initial service details.

Vehicle concerns may require inspection or diagnostic work before the cause, repair scope, parts requirements, price or completion time can be confirmed. Additional issues discovered during service will be discussed where reasonably possible before extra work proceeds.
Customers should provide accurate vehicle and contact information, disclose relevant symptoms or previous repair history, remove valuables and collect vehicles according to the agreed arrangements.

Any parts or workmanship warranty will depend on the specific service, supplied part and written terms provided for that job. Normal wear, misuse, accidents, unrelated faults and work performed by others may be excluded.
Links to maps, social platforms or third-party websites are provided for convenience. DriveCore is not responsible for third-party content, availability or privacy practices.
To the extent permitted by law, DriveCore is not responsible for losses arising solely from reliance on general website information or from interruptions outside its reasonable control.
These website terms are governed by the laws of Trinidad and Tobago.
Questions may be directed to drive.core@outlook.com or 1 868 375 9633.
